# Food image recognition assets

This directory contains browser builds of TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 and the
TensorFlow.js MobileNet model package 2.1.1. The model files in the adjacent
`tfjs-models/mobilenet-v2-050` directory are MobileNet V2 0.50 ImageNet
classification assets distributed by TensorFlow Hub.

TensorFlow.js and TensorFlow.js Models are licensed under the Apache License
2.0. Their source and license information are available at:

- https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs
- https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models
- https://tfhub.dev/google/imagenet/mobilenet_v2_050_224/classification/2
